question_en: How's the weather outside today? And do you have any fun plans for the evening?
question_zh: 今天外面天气怎么样？你晚上有什么有趣的计划吗？

options.answer_en: It's actually quite chilly and windy today, so I'm wearing a heavy coat. As for the evening, I don't have anything big planned. I'm just planning to order some takeout, maybe some noodles, and binge-watch a new series on Netflix to unwind after a long day.
options.answer_zh: 今天外面其实挺冷的，风也很大，所以我穿了厚外套。至于晚上，没什么大计划。我打算点个外卖，可能吃碗面，然后在 Netflix 上追一部新剧，忙碌了一天之后放松一下。

notes.explanation_zh: big 放在不定代词 anything 后面修饰；planned 是过去分词，表示已经安排好的事情。整个短语表示“什么大计划”。
现在进行时可用来表达近期正在考虑或安排的打算，语气自然随意。
一口气连续刷很多集电视剧。例如：I binge-watched the whole season over the weekend.

options.answer_en: The weather is surprisingly nice! The sun is shining and it's not too hot. I'm actually meeting up with a couple of friends later. We're going to try that new hotpot place downtown, and hopefully, we can grab a bubble tea afterwards to catch up.
options.answer_zh: 天气出奇地好！阳光明媚，而且不太热。我晚些时候要见几个朋友。我们打算去市中心那家新开的火锅店尝尝，希望之后还能喝杯奶茶、聊聊近况。

notes.explanation_zh: 现在进行时表达已安排好的未来活动，尤其常用于约见朋友。
grab 在口语里有“顺便买/喝”的意思，轻松自然。
这里指叙旧、聊近况。例如：Let's catch up over coffee.

options.answer_en: It looks like it might rain later, so you might want to bring an umbrella. My evening is going to be pretty busy, unfortunately. I have to finish a report for work, and then I need to spend an hour practicing my English before going to bed.
options.answer_zh: 看起来晚些时候可能会下雨，你最好带把伞。不巧的是，我晚上会很忙。我得完成一份工作报告，然后睡前还要花一小时练习英语。

notes.explanation_zh: 表示“看起来好像……”，后面可直接接完整句子。
表达委婉的建议，相当于“你或许可以考虑……”。
表示“花时间做某事”，spend 后接动名词，例如 spend an hour practicing English。

question_en: What does your morning routine usually look like? Do you have time to eat breakfast before you head out?
question_zh: 你早上通常都怎么安排？出门前有时间吃早餐吗？

options.answer_en: I usually get up around seven and give myself a little time to wake up properly. I make myself a cup of coffee, put together a quick breakfast, and check my schedule for the day. I find that having a calm morning puts me in a much better mood, even when I have a lot on my plate.
options.answer_zh: 我通常七点左右起床，给自己一点时间彻底清醒过来。我会给自己泡杯咖啡，简单做份早餐，再看看当天的日程。我发现，早晨从容一点会让我心情好很多，即使有一大堆事情要忙也是如此。

notes.term: give myself a little time to...
notes.explanation_zh: 给自己留一点时间去做某事。give someone time to do something 是很自然的搭配。例如：Give yourself some time to adjust.（给自己一点时间适应。）
put together 在这里指用现有材料快速准备、拼凑出一份早餐，比 cook breakfast 更强调简单省事。

notes.term: have a lot on my plate
notes.explanation_zh: 字面意思是盘子里有很多东西，口语里表示手头事情很多、忙不过来。例如：I've got a lot on my plate this week.

options.answer_en: To be honest, my mornings are usually pretty chaotic. I tend to hit the snooze button a few times, so I end up rushing out the door. Most days, I just grab a sandwich on my way to work. I'm trying to get into the habit of going to bed earlier so I can stop feeling so rushed.
options.answer_zh: 说实话，我的早晨通常都有点手忙脚乱。我总会按好几次闹钟的贪睡键，结果最后只能匆匆忙忙地出门。大多数时候，我就在上班路上随便买个三明治。我正努力养成早点睡觉的习惯，这样早上就不会总觉得这么赶。

notes.explanation_zh: 表示“往往会……／通常容易……”，用来描述某种习惯或倾向。例如：I tend to stay up late.（我经常熬夜。）
表示“结果最后还是做了某事”，常常带有事情并非原计划的意味。end up 后接动词 -ing。例如：We ended up taking a taxi.

notes.term: get into the habit of doing something
notes.explanation_zh: 表示“逐渐养成做某事的习惯”。介词 of 后面接动名词，例如：get into the habit of reading every day.

options.answer_en: Since I work from home, I don't have to commute, which makes mornings a lot less stressful. I usually stretch for ten minutes, make some oatmeal, and ease into the day by checking my emails. Once I've figured out my priorities, I get straight to work. It's a routine that helps me stay focused without feeling overwhelmed.
options.answer_zh: 因为我在家办公，不用通勤，所以早上轻松多了。我通常先拉伸十分钟，煮点燕麦粥，然后从查看邮件开始，慢慢进入一天的状态。一旦理清了事情的轻重缓急，我就马上开始工作。这个习惯能让我保持专注，又不会觉得压力大到喘不过气。

notes.term: which makes mornings a lot less stressful
notes.explanation_zh: 这里的 which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面“不用通勤”这件事，说明它带来的结果。a lot 可加强比较级 less 的程度。
ease into 表示“慢慢进入、逐渐适应”，这里指不匆忙地开始一天。也可以说 ease into a new routine（慢慢适应新作息）。
表示“直接开始工作、马上投入工作”；straight to 强调不拖延、不绕弯。例如：After breakfast, I get straight to work.

question_en: How do you usually spend your weekends? Do you prefer making plans or just going with the flow?
question_zh: 你通常怎么度过周末？你更喜欢提前安排好，还是顺其自然？

options.answer_en: I usually keep my weekends pretty low-key. After a busy week, I like sleeping in a little, making myself a nice breakfast, and catching up on a show I've been meaning to watch. I try not to pack my schedule too tightly because I need some downtime to recharge.
options.answer_zh: 我的周末通常过得比较悠闲。忙了一周之后，我喜欢稍微睡个懒觉、给自己做顿好吃的早餐，再补看一部一直想看的剧。我尽量不把日程排得太满，因为我需要一些休息时间恢复精力。

notes.explanation_zh: 表示让某件事保持低调、简单、不折腾。keep my weekends low-key 就是周末安排得轻松一点。
表示补上之前没来得及做的事，例如 catch up on sleep（补觉）或 catch up on a show（补剧）。
现在完成进行时，表示一直有这个打算，却还没付诸行动。例如：I've been meaning to call you.（我一直想给你打电话。）
downtime 指休息、空闲时间；recharge 字面是充电，口语中指恢复精力。

options.answer_en: I prefer having at least one thing planned so I have something to look forward to. This weekend, I'm thinking of checking out a new café with a friend. We haven't seen each other in ages, so it'll be nice to catch up. Apart from that, I'll probably just go with the flow.
options.answer_zh: 我更喜欢至少提前安排一件事，这样就有个盼头。这个周末我打算和朋友去一家新咖啡馆看看。我们已经很久没见了，所以能聊聊近况应该挺开心的。除此之外，我大概就随性安排了。

notes.term: have something to look forward to
notes.explanation_zh: 表示有值得期待的事情。look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。
check out 在口语中表示去看看、体验一下某个地方，不是“检查”或“结账”的意思。

notes.term: haven't seen each other in ages
notes.explanation_zh: 现在完成时描述从过去延续到现在的未见面状态；in ages 是口语夸张说法，表示很久。
表示顺其自然、不做太多计划，常用于描述周末或旅行安排。

options.answer_en: I like to strike a balance between getting things done and taking it easy. On Saturday mornings, I usually spend a couple of hours studying or working on a personal project. Once that's out of the way, I can enjoy the rest of the weekend without feeling guilty about unfinished tasks.
options.answer_zh: 我喜欢在完成任务和放松之间找到平衡。周六早上，我通常会花几个小时学习或做自己的项目。等这些事处理完，我就可以安心享受剩下的周末，而不用因为任务没完成而有负担。

notes.term: strike a balance between A and B
notes.explanation_zh: 表示在 A 和 B 之间取得平衡。between 后的两个部分通常采用平行结构，例如 getting things done 和 taking it easy。
表示花时间做某事，spend 后接时间，doing 表示具体活动，例如 spend two hours studying。

notes.term: once that's out of the way
notes.explanation_zh: once 引导时间状语从句，表示“一旦”；out of the way 指某件需要处理的事情已经完成、不再碍事。
without 是介词，后接动名词 feeling；feel guilty about 表示因为某事感到内疚。

question_en: Do you usually cook at home or eat out? What do you do when you don't have much time to prepare a meal?
question_zh: 你通常在家做饭还是出去吃？如果没多少时间准备一顿饭，你会怎么做？

options.answer_en: I prefer cooking at home because I can decide exactly what goes into my food. I usually pick up a few fresh ingredients on my way back from work and throw together something simple, like noodles with vegetables. It doesn't have to be fancy as long as it tastes good and fills me up.
options.answer_zh: 我更喜欢在家做饭，因为我可以自己决定食物里放什么。我通常下班回家路上顺便买些新鲜食材，然后简单做点吃的，比如蔬菜面。只要好吃又能吃饱，就不一定非得做得很精致。

notes.explanation_zh: what 引导宾语从句，作 decide 的宾语；go into 在这里表示“被用作……的原料”，而不是字面上的“走进去”。
pick up 在购物语境中表示顺便买、买一点东西，比 buy 更有随手采购的感觉。
throw together 表示用手头现有的东西快速做出某物，强调省时、不复杂。

notes.term: as long as it tastes good
notes.explanation_zh: as long as 引导条件状语从句，表示“只要……就……”。这里用一般现在时表达通常成立的条件。

options.answer_en: On busy weekdays, I don't always have the energy to cook from scratch. I try to keep a few easy options in the fridge, so I can heat something up instead of ordering takeout every time. If I'm really pressed for time, I'll make a sandwich or scramble a couple of eggs. That usually does the trick.
options.answer_zh: 工作日忙的时候，我不一定有精力从头开始做饭。我会尽量在冰箱里备几样简单方便的食物，这样就能热一下吃，而不是每次都点外卖。如果时间实在很紧，我就做个三明治或者炒两个鸡蛋。这样通常就够了。

notes.explanation_zh: from scratch 表示从零开始、从最基本的原料做起。cook from scratch 就是不用现成半成品，从头做饭。
instead of 表示“而不是”，其中 of 是介词，后接动名词 ordering。takeout 指外卖食物。
固定口语表达，表示时间紧迫、赶时间。例如：I'm pressed for time this morning.（我今天早上时间很紧。）
口语中表示奏效、达到预期目的。That usually does the trick 意思是“那样通常就能解决问题”。

options.title_en: Cooking as a Way to Unwind
options.answer_en: I actually enjoy cooking when I have some free time. I like looking up new recipes and trying them out on the weekend. Sometimes a dish doesn't turn out the way I expected, but that's part of the fun. I find it relaxing to put on some music and take my time in the kitchen.
options.answer_zh: 其实有空的时候我挺享受做饭的。我喜欢找些新菜谱，周末试着做一做。有时候成品和我想象的不太一样，但这也是乐趣的一部分。我觉得放点音乐，在厨房里慢慢做饭是一件很放松的事。

notes.explanation_zh: look up 表示查找资料或信息；recipe 是“菜谱”。look up a recipe 就是查菜谱。
try out 表示实际试用、尝试某个方法或东西。这里 them 指前面的 recipes，代词作宾语时放在 try 和 out 之间。

notes.term: doesn't turn out the way I expected
notes.explanation_zh: turn out 表示最后结果如何；the way I expected 表示“像我预期的那样”，整个表达指结果不如预想。
表示不着急、慢慢来。take one's time 是固定表达，不是“占用我的时间”。

question_en: How do you usually get to work or school? What do you like to do during your commute?
question_zh: 你通常怎么去上班或上学？通勤路上你喜欢做些什么？

options.title_en: Making the Most of the Ride
options.answer_en: I usually take the subway because it's more reliable than driving during rush hour. The ride takes about half an hour, so I use that time to listen to an English podcast or review a few new words. It makes the commute feel a lot shorter, and I get a little learning done before the day even starts.
options.answer_zh: 我通常坐地铁，因为在早晚高峰时它比开车更可靠。车程大约半小时，所以我会利用这段时间听英语播客，或者复习几个新单词。这样通勤感觉短了很多，而且一天还没正式开始，我就已经学了一点东西。

notes.explanation_zh: reliable 表示可靠、准时；more ... than ... 是比较级结构。than 后用 driving（动名词），与前面乘地铁的方式进行比较。
rush hour 指上下班交通高峰期；during 后接名词，表示在某段时间内。

notes.term: use that time to listen to...
notes.explanation_zh: use something to do something 表示利用某物做某事；这里 to listen 是目的不定式，不是介词。
get something done 表示把某件事完成；a little learning 表示一点学习任务，强调利用零碎时间有所收获。

options.answer_en: I normally walk to work, which takes around twenty minutes. I actually enjoy having some quiet time before I get to the office. If the weather's nice, I'll take a slightly longer route through the park. I'd rather arrive a few minutes later than start my day feeling rushed.
options.answer_zh: 我一般步行上班，大概需要二十分钟。其实我很享受到办公室之前的这段安静时间。如果天气不错，我会稍微绕远一点，从公园穿过去。我宁愿晚几分钟到，也不想一大早就匆匆忙忙的。

notes.explanation_zh: which 引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明前面步行上班这件事所需的时间；逗号不能省略。
have some quiet time 表示享受一段安静、不被打扰的时间；some 用来表示不确定数量的时间。
slightly 修饰比较级 longer，表示稍微更长一点；take a route 表示选择或走某条路线。
I'd rather 是 I would rather 的缩写，表示宁愿……也不……；后面接动词原形，如 arrive 和 start。

options.answer_en: My commute can be pretty hectic, especially when the buses are running late. I try to leave a bit earlier so I don't have to worry about being late. If I get stuck in traffic, I usually put on some music and remind myself there's no point in getting worked up over something I can't control.
options.answer_zh: 我的通勤有时挺折腾的，尤其是公交车晚点的时候。我会尽量早点出门，这样就不用担心迟到。如果遇到堵车，我通常会放点音乐，并提醒自己：对无法控制的事情生气也没什么用。

notes.explanation_zh: can be 表示有时可能会处于某种状态，不代表一直如此；pretty 在口语中可以表示相当、挺。

notes.term: so I don't have to worry about being late
notes.explanation_zh: so 引导结果或目的；worry about 后接动名词 being，表示担心迟到这件事。
固定搭配，表示被堵在路上；get stuck 强调陷入某种难以脱身的状态。

notes.term: there's no point in getting worked up
notes.explanation_zh: there's no point in doing something 表示做某事没有意义；get worked up 表示情绪激动、生气或焦虑。

question_en: How do you keep in touch with friends when life gets busy?
question_zh: 生活忙起来的时候，你是怎么和朋友保持联系的？

options.title_en: Little Things Go a Long Way
options.answer_en: I don't always have time for a long conversation, but I try to check in with my friends every now and then. Sometimes I'll send them a funny video or a quick message just to let them know I'm thinking of them. It doesn't take much effort, but it goes a long way toward keeping us close.
options.answer_zh: 我不一定总有时间长聊，但我会尽量时不时问候一下朋友。有时我会给他们发个搞笑视频或简短的消息，只是想让他们知道我惦记着他们。这不需要花多少精力，却很有助于维持我们亲近的关系。

notes.explanation_zh: not always 表示并非总是，而不是从来不；have time for 后接名词，表示有时间做某事。
主动联系某人，问问近况；every now and then 表示时不时。

notes.term: let them know I'm thinking of them
notes.explanation_zh: let + 宾语 + 动词原形；know 后接省略 that 的宾语从句。think of someone 在这里表示惦记某人。

notes.term: go a long way toward doing
notes.explanation_zh: 表示对实现某个目标很有帮助；toward 是介词，后接动名词 keeping。

options.answer_en: A few of my friends live in different cities, so getting together isn't always easy. We try to set aside some time for a video call once in a while. Even if we haven't spoken in weeks, we can usually pick up right where we left off. That's what I really value about those friendships.
options.answer_zh: 我的几个朋友住在不同的城市，所以见面并不总是容易。我们会尽量偶尔留出一点时间视频聊天。即使我们已经好几个星期没聊过，也通常能接着上次的话题自然地聊下去。这正是我特别珍惜这些友谊的地方。

notes.explanation_zh: getting together 是动名词短语作主语，表示聚在一起、见面，谓语用单数 isn't。
特意留出时间给某项活动；once in a while 表示偶尔。

notes.term: even if we haven't spoken in weeks
notes.explanation_zh: even if 引导让步状语从句；现在完成时表示从过去到现在已有数周没有交谈。

notes.term: pick up right where we left off
notes.explanation_zh: 表示从上次中断的地方继续；where 引导地点状语从句，right 强调恰好。

options.answer_en: I've learned not to take it personally when someone takes a while to reply. Everyone has their own stuff going on, and I know I'm not great at replying straight away either. As long as we make an effort to be there for each other when it matters, I don't think we need to talk every single day.
options.answer_zh: 我已经学会了在别人过了一段时间才回复时，不把这件事当成针对自己。每个人都有自己的事情要忙，我也知道自己并不擅长马上回复消息。只要我们在重要的时候努力陪伴和支持彼此，我觉得就没必要每天都聊天。

notes.term: learned not to take it personally
notes.explanation_zh: learn not to do 表示学会不做某事；take it personally 表示把某件事理解为针对自己而感到受伤。
take a while to do 表示做某事需要一段时间；someone 是单数，因此使用 takes。

notes.term: have their own stuff going on
notes.explanation_zh: 口语中 stuff 泛指事情；going on 描述正在发生的事情，整句表示各自有事情要忙。
be great at doing 表示擅长做某事；either 放在否定句末尾，表示也不。

notes.term: as long as ... be there for each other
notes.explanation_zh: as long as 表示只要，引导条件状语从句；be there for someone 表示在某人需要时给予陪伴和支持。

question_en: Do you think you spend too much time on your phone? What do you do to cut down on screen time?
question_zh: 你觉得自己花在手机上的时间太多了吗？你会做些什么来减少屏幕使用时间？

options.answer_en: I tend to reach for my phone whenever I have a spare moment. Before I know it, I've spent half an hour scrolling through social media. Lately, I've been trying to be more mindful of how I spend my time. Instead of checking my phone out of habit, I ask myself whether there's actually something I need to do.
options.answer_zh: 每当有一点空闲时间，我就习惯性地拿起手机。不知不觉间，我已经花了半个小时刷社交媒体。最近，我一直在努力更加留意自己是如何利用时间的。我不再习惯性地查看手机，而是问问自己是否真的有什么事情需要处理。

notes.term: tend to reach for my phone
notes.explanation_zh: tend to do 表示倾向于做某事；reach for 表示伸手去拿某物。

notes.term: whenever I have a spare moment
notes.explanation_zh: whenever 表示每当，引导时间状语从句；a spare moment 表示一点空闲时间。
固定口语表达，表示不知不觉间、还没反应过来。

notes.term: I've spent half an hour scrolling
notes.explanation_zh: spend + 时间 + doing 表示花费时间做某事。这里使用现在完成时，强调已经花掉的时间。
现在完成进行时，强调从过去持续到现在的努力。
出于习惯。这里的 out of 表示行为产生的原因或动机。

options.answer_en: What works best for me is keeping my phone out of sight while I'm working. I also turn off notifications that aren't important so that I'm less tempted to check it. It took me a while to get used to it, but I've noticed that I can get a lot more done without constantly getting distracted.
options.answer_zh: 对我来说，最有效的方法是在工作时把手机放在看不见的地方。我也会关闭不重要的通知，这样就不太容易忍不住查看手机。我花了一段时间才适应，但我发现，在不频繁分心的情况下，我能够完成更多事情。

notes.explanation_zh: what 引导主语从句，整体表示对我来说最有效的方法。

notes.term: keep my phone out of sight
notes.explanation_zh: keep + 宾语 + 宾语补足语，表示让某物保持某种状态；out of sight 表示在视线之外。

notes.term: so that I'm less tempted to check it
notes.explanation_zh: so that 引导目的状语从句；be tempted to do 表示忍不住想做某事。
表示逐渐适应某事。这里的 to 是介词，如果后面接动词，需要使用动名词形式。
get + 宾语 + 过去分词，这里表示完成更多事情。
without 后接动名词；get distracted 表示变得分心。

options.answer_en: I wouldn't say that using my phone is necessarily a bad thing. It comes in handy when I need to look something up or stay in touch with people. The problem is when I end up using it just to kill time. Rather than giving it up altogether, I'd rather find a balance and make sure it doesn't get in the way of things that matter to me.
options.answer_zh: 我不会说使用手机就一定是一件坏事。当我需要查找信息或与他人保持联系时，手机非常方便。问题在于，我有时最后只是用它来打发时间。与其彻底放弃使用手机，我更愿意找到一种平衡，确保它不会妨碍那些对我而言重要的事情。

notes.explanation_zh: 一种比较委婉的表达方式，表示我不认为……、我不会说……。
表示不一定，而不是完全否定。
固定口语表达，表示派上用场、非常方便。
表示最终做了某事，通常强调实际结果与原本的计划不同。

notes.term: rather than giving it up altogether
notes.explanation_zh: rather than 表示而不是、与其；altogether 表示完全、彻底。
I'd rather 是 I would rather 的缩写，后接动词原形，表示我更愿意……。
表示妨碍、阻碍某事；things that matter to me 中的 that 引导定语从句，修饰 things。

question_en: How do you usually make decisions when you're not sure what to do?
question_zh: 当你不确定该怎么办时，你通常是如何做决定的？

options.answer_en: I usually give myself some time to think things through. If it's a big decision, I try to weigh the pros and cons rather than rush into anything. Writing down my options helps me figure out what matters most to me. Once I've made up my mind, I try not to second-guess myself.
options.answer_zh: 我通常会给自己一些时间仔细考虑。如果是重大决定，我会尽量权衡利弊，而不是仓促行事。把各种选择写下来能帮助我弄清楚自己最看重什么。一旦下定决心，我就尽量不再反复怀疑自己的决定。

notes.explanation_zh: 表示把事情从头到尾考虑清楚；through 强调考虑的完整性。
表示权衡利弊；weigh 在这里不是称重量，而是仔细衡量。
rather than 表示而不是；rush into 表示未经充分考虑就仓促做某事。

notes.term: figure out what matters most to me
notes.explanation_zh: figure out 表示弄清楚；what matters most to me 是宾语从句，what 在从句中作主语。

notes.term: once I've made up my mind
notes.explanation_zh: once 引导时间状语从句，表示一旦；现在完成时强调下定决心这一动作已经完成。make up one's mind 表示下定决心。
表示反复怀疑自己的判断或已经做出的决定。

options.answer_en: When I'm torn between two options, I often talk it over with someone I trust. They might bring up something I haven't thought of. That doesn't mean I let other people decide for me, though. I just find it helpful to hear a different perspective before making the final call.
options.answer_zh: 当我在两个选择之间犹豫不决时，我经常会找一个信任的人商量。他们可能会提出一些我没想到的事情。不过，这并不意味着我让别人替我做决定。我只是觉得，在最终拍板之前听听不同的观点很有帮助。

notes.explanation_zh: 表示在两个选择之间左右为难；torn 是 tear 的过去分词，这里描述内心纠结的状态。
表示和某人充分讨论某件事；it 是代词，要放在 talk 和 over 之间。

notes.term: bring up something I haven't thought of
notes.explanation_zh: bring up 表示提出话题；I haven't thought of 是省略关系代词 that 的定语从句，修饰 something。
mean 后接省略 that 的宾语从句；though 放在句末表示不过，常用于口语转折。
find + it + 形容词 + 不定式；it 是形式宾语，真正的宾语是后面的 to hear 短语。
表示作出最终决定、最终拍板；call 在这里指判断或决定。

options.answer_en: I've realized that there's no point in waiting until I'm completely sure about everything. For smaller decisions, I'd rather give something a try and see how it goes. Even if things don't turn out the way I expected, I can always adjust along the way. Sometimes taking action is the only way to find out what works.
options.answer_zh: 我意识到，等到自己对所有事情都完全有把握是没有意义的。对于较小的决定，我更愿意先尝试一下，看看结果如何。即使事情没有像我预期的那样发展，我也可以在过程中随时调整。有时候，只有采取行动才能知道什么方法有效。

notes.explanation_zh: 表示做某事没有意义；in 是介词，后接动名词。

notes.term: I'd rather give something a try
notes.explanation_zh: would rather 后接动词原形，表示更愿意；give something a try 表示尝试一下某事。
表示看看事情进展如何；how it goes 是宾语从句，使用陈述语序。

notes.term: turn out the way I expected
notes.explanation_zh: turn out 表示最终结果如何；the way I expected 表示按照我预期的方式。
along the way 表示在过程中、一路上；adjust 表示根据实际情况作出调整。

notes.term: the only way to find out what works
notes.explanation_zh: to find out 是修饰 way 的不定式；what works 是 find out 的宾语从句，表示什么方法有效。
